answer: An attacker running 123 aliases hence needs 22 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are entered in ferrous, expire in crystal, and zephyr lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3903 identities would post 2546 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
